title: SIGNAL / NOISE
hook: A field of noise is physically crushed into one idea, then printed into an explosive poster.
shots: Oversized NOISE slices collide in an optical tunnel.
Clipped percussion, narrow-band static and panned clicks.
A large pointer pins one dot; the chaos gets pulled into its orbit.
Click causes the suction; dry air acceleration.
Compression lands as one giant IDEA. A black stripe carries the scene.
Heavy print impact; clean beat gap.
The word unfolds into a radial typographic machine.
Rhythmic ratchet, four rising mechanical taps.
A final MAKE IT MOVE poster locks into place with a visible print smear.
Bass hit with a short room; restrained closing rhythm.
reviewStatus: completed direction draft; visual review in DRAFT_REVIEW.md
